```bash
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/trello.com/urls?limit=20&cursor=tr_cursor1" \

```

This will return a JSON payload containing up to 20 URLs linked to `trello.com`, along with pagination information (including the next cursor). If you run into rate‑limiting or other issues, check your API quota and make sure you’re respecting the limits set by VirusTotal.
